name: Fern
self_text: I'm an Italian guy in my late 20s who spends free time fermenting hot sauce. I use a Sony and honestly, I'm just looking for a relaxed photo walk. I tend to go at a moderate pace, that's how I enjoy it. I'm cool with taking portraits of each other. Gear talk is fine but not the point is my thing, and I'd like someone to teach me post-processing. Most weeks I can do Saturday morning or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either on Saturday morning or weekday evenings. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a fast pace or a slow pace, though it's not a requirement.
